text.p: These are the main stories in Latvian newspapers on Friday. Prepared for Reuters by the Co-operation Fund. Reuters has not verified these reports and does not vouch for their accuracy:
- Prime minister designate Guntars Krasts said that the plans for a balanced budget in 1997 were out of reach and that the deficit could amount to as much as 12 million lats.

- Riga City Council has received the audit from Deloitte & Touche on last year's city budget and bank accounts. Deloitte & Touche concluded that the Riga city budget of 1996 was balanced and competently managed.
- Latvia will pass a note to the European Commission and all EU member states pointing out the mistakes made by the commission in its assessment of Latvia's readiness to begin EU entry talks.
